title: bidet
tagline: "Tag"-like game where people infect other people scanning NFC wristbands with ZK proofs
description:
When players are caught a ZK proof is created on the catcher's phone and then submitted to a verifier smart contact on a Saga chainlet that verifies that that specific player has been caught without disclosing who has been caught.

The ZK proof is created using Circom and Mopro directly on the catchers' phone.
